fato_historico: 2015: A 8.3 Mw earthquake strikes the Chilean city of Illapel, killing 15 people, injuring at least 34, leaving at least six missing, and causing extensive damage. One person also dies in Argentina.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos suggests you may feel the earth shift beneath your feet today. Much like the resilient spirit of those who rebuild after tremors, you are finding your footing. It is a good time to ground your ethereal energy and nurture your deep emotional roots, turning any sudden turbulence into a beautiful opportunity for personal growth and profound self-reflection.
frase_do_dia: Even when the earth shakes, your spirit remains a lighthouse of calm grace.
significado_numero: Represents the transformative power of healing and spiritual reconstruction.
conselho: Trust your intuition and remain steady during moments of unexpected change.
